audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Sion, Sion, Skill, Skill, Sion, Sion in both layers.
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Sion, Poppy, Sion, Sion and the mirror already flipped exactly these four rows as one group. The matchup's own explanations agree: whys[1] and whys[2] describe her owning levels 2-3, whys[3] says the lane stabilises in your favour at 4-5, whys[4] says she retakes the threat window at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 4 flipped as matched pairs in both layers, ratings moved to follow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors: Hammer Shock is repeatedly called a knockup she procs off the wall stun; Steadfast Presence is described as blocking Sion's 'dash options'; and wants.you[0] tells you to charge Q to 'break Poppy's W anti-dash stance'.
audit.why: Hammer Shock (Q, 8/7/6/5/4s, 430 range) is a slow zone that explodes after a delay — no displacement. Steadfast Presence (W, 20-12s) is passive armour and MR that grows as she drops, with an active that stops enemy DASHES. Sion has no dash anywhere in his kit, so it never interacts with him — and a charged Decimating Smash is a ground slam, so there is nothing for her stance to stop.
audit.corrected: Hammer Shock restated as the exploding slow zone; the anti-dash stance restated as irrelevant to you rather than something to break.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid told the player to re-engage 'when the 110-second cooldown is burning'.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict is 140/120/100 — 140 at rank 1, a 30-second error on the timer that decides whether your R engage is safe. Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10.
audit.corrected: 140s written into mid and spikes[1]; Heroic Charge's 14s into whys[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said she is untargetable while channelling Keeper's Verdict.
audit.why: Spending a combo into the channel wastes it — the correct play is to wait it out or step clear of the knockback line.

edits.before: Poppy's Heroic Charge (E) wall-stun activates at level 2 and her Q knockup off the stun gives her a full free combo; wall-hug is the one thing that loses this lane outright.
edits.after: Heroic Charge (E, 14s at rank 1) pins you to a wall for the stun, and Hammer Shock's zone explodes on top of you — hugging the side walls loses this lane outright.

edits.before: With E and Q both up she has her core stun-into-knockup pattern fully assembled and you have no reliable answer to the wall angle without your W-shield already raised.
edits.after: With Heroic Charge and Hammer Shock both up her stun-into-zone pattern is assembled, and you have no answer to the wall angle unless Soul Furnace is already raised.

edits.before: Poppy's E-into-wall stun comes fully online — keep wall distance and don't let her proc a full Q knockup off the stun.
edits.after: Heroic Charge into a wall comes fully online — keep wall distance so she cannot stun you into a Hammer Shock zone.

edits.before: Poppy's R knockback is her best anti-engage tool — it interrupts your Unstoppable Onslaught and resets your all-in, so bait the R before committing.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (140s at rank 1) is her anti-engage — she is untargetable in the channel and the knockback resets your all-in, so bait it before committing.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your relative breathing room — she has all her tools but no ultimate and her damage without the wall stun is modest. You can start holding a charged Q in the brush angle to stun her when she walks up to CS; the long charge time is less punishing now because she has no disengage dash to escape the telegraph. Her W (Steadfast Presence) passive does not block your Q since it is a ground slam, not a dash, so the charged knockup always threatens. At 6 she gets Keeper's Verdict and the equation shifts back — a short-charge R can knock you airborne instantly, and a full-channel R sends you across the map. Never start your Unstoppable Onslaught into a Poppy who has R available; bait the Verdict by walking aggressively at her, then disengage when she flashes the channel, and re-engage when the 110-second cooldown is burning.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your relative breathing room — she has all her tools but no ultimate and her damage without the wall stun is modest. You can start holding a charged Q in the brush angle to stun her when she walks up to CS; the long charge time is less punishing now because she has no disengage dash to escape the telegraph. Steadfast Presence only stops dashes and you have none, so the charged knockup always threatens. At 6 she gets Keeper's Verdict and the equation shifts back — she is untargetable while she channels it and the knockback throws you clean out of the fight. Never start Unstoppable Onslaught into a Poppy holding R; bait the Verdict by walking at her, disengage when the channel flashes, and re-engage while the 140-second cooldown burns.

edits.before: Land a fully charged Q knockup to break Poppy's W anti-dash stance and open the E-armor-shred follow-up
edits.after: Land the fully charged Q knockup — Steadfast Presence stops dashes, and a ground slam is not one

edits.before: Force short auto-trade patterns where her W (Steadfast Presence) blocks your dash options and her Q poke chips your HP before trades
edits.after: Force short auto-trades where Steadfast Presence's armour and MR blunt you and Hammer Shock's zone chips your HP before every commit

notes: The packet suspectName "Use Keeper's Verdict" is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name. Kept from the mirror rather than re-litigated: Keeper's Verdict's displacement interrupting a Decimating Smash charge. Not asserted: whether a short-charge Verdict behaves differently from a full channel — the previous text claimed a two-tier effect and Riot's description says only that she channels a strike that knocks enemies very far away, so the tier claim is gone rather than guessed. Full-layer prose carries mojibake em-dashes on disk and was left untouched; note also that several full-layer strings refer to Poppy as 'him' ('so Poppy overextends into your pattern... starve him', 'if he gets ahead') — template text that should be regendered outside this audit.
